ETH half-size when prev-day range<3.16% AND 10d trail<4%. 200 coin-days halfsize. Loses 22% return, flat Sharpe.
ETH no-new-entries on low-vol days (existing positions run exits). 200 coin-days no_entry. Loses 36% return.
All 3 coins half-size on their own low-vol days. 505 coin-days halfsize. Loses 35% return. +0.04 Sharpe (essentially zero).
ETH skip when prev-day |funding| > 95th pctile. 48 coin-days skipped. Loses 25% return.
